plugins.name: corebee
plugins.description: Set up AI customer support from your terminal, then run it from your editor. No Corebee account yet? Run /corebee:signup: one email approval, and your agent gets back a chat widget snippet, a provisioned workspace, and a docs crawl already running. No dashboard visit needed. Already a customer? Triage conversations, manage contacts and knowledge base, read analytics, and configure the widget. Hosted MCP server with OAuth. 10 skills, 4 agents, 4 commands. 14-day trial, no card.
